findings.summary: 009-legacy-handoff-template.md is a blank legacy template (title identical to the 000 template placeholder, no session content) yet is classified included=true as a session record. The governing contract (CENSUS-HANDOFF / SC-03-P, node-01b revision) requires templates to default to inclusion_status=excluded with exclusion_reason=EX-template, and explicitly lists 'treat templates as project history' as a FAIL condition. This misclassification changes what the downstream handoff source layer will ingest.

The VM-only axis is unresolved without evidence. The constraint requires probing the VM surfaces named in AGENTS.md (sab-dev) and .handoffs/030 (khoj-38:~/corpus-work/session-review/ with ~35 cleaned UA sessions, from-air/, git-maps/) and marking unreachable artifacts missing with evidence of unreachability. The manifest asserts vm_only=false on all 26 rows with only an acknowledgment note ('not verifiable from this checkout'); no probe attempt or unreachability evidence exists anywhere under part2/. This under-delivers the node's why ('resolve ... VM-only ... artifacts') and skirts the 'never drop silently' constraint.

Missing artifacts (001, 003-008, 016-019) exist only as a census-level array, not as per-artifact presence=missing stub rows as the contract's CENSUS-HANDOFF requires ('stub missing 000-036'). Exact reproduction of the excluded set is weaker than the contract's 'one row per census hit' design.

The duplicate|moved|unique and current|superseded classification axes from memo section 05 are absent from manifest entries; only git-backed|VM-only (vm_only) and dated|temporally-ambiguous (occurred_at + basis) are implemented, plus census-level present|missing. The five-axis resolution promised by the node's why is only partially delivered.

import pathlib, json, hashlib, re, subprocess
# Replicate build_handoff_manifest.py logic read-only against current .handoffs/ to see what regeneration yields
HANDOFF_DIR = pathlib.Path('.handoffs')
DATE_LINE = re.compile(r"^Date:\s*(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})", re.MULTILINE)
ISO_ANY = re.compile(r"20\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{2}")
NUM = re.compile(r"^(\d{3})-")
def git_added(path):
    r = subprocess.run(["git","log","--diff-filter=A","--follow","--format=%aI","--",str(path)], cwd=".", capture_output=True, text=True)
    lines = [l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l.strip()]
    return lines[-1] if lines else ""
def occurred_at(path):
    text = path.read_text(errors="replace")
    m = DATE_LINE.search(text)
    if m: return m.group(1), "header-date-line"
    b = ISO_ANY.search(text)
    if b: return b.group(0), "body-first-iso-mention"
    return None, "absent-in-document"
entries=[]; present=set()
for path in sorted(HANDOFF_DIR.glob("*.md")):
    m = NUM.match(path.name)
    num = int(m.group(1)) if m else None
    if num: present.add(num)
    entries.append((num, path.name))
maxn = max(present) if present else 0
gaps = [n for n in range(1, maxn+1) if n not in present]
print("files on disk now:", len(entries))
print("max number:", maxn)
print("missing numbers:", gaps)
print("numbers with duplicate files:", sorted({n for n,_ in entries if sum(1 for x,_ in entries if x==n)>1}))
EOF

decision_reasoning: Node-05's deliverable (handoff-manifest.jsonl + build_handoff_manifest.py, the only two files in the subject diff, both under part2/ — no scope violation) is a mechanically sound, deterministic enumeration of the 26 .handoffs/*.md files present in the checkout, with per-entry hashes and chronology fields. It matches the evidence contract's live facts for counts (26 files; missing 1,3-8,16-19). However, it does not meet the node's central acceptance criterion: the manifest fails to classify each artifact on the required axes. The duplicate|moved|unique and current|superseded axes are entirely absent from the entry schema even though git history proves moved artifacts exist (002/023/024 renamed in 678b9b7), the present|missing axis is not per-artifact (no stub entries for the 11 missing numbers, contrary to the contract's CENSUS-HANDOFF 'stub missing 000-036'), and the git-backed|VM-only axis was never actually probed — AGENTS.md (VM sab-dev) and .handoffs/030 (khoj-38) name VM surfaces the contract says to probe, and the manifest records no probe nor EX-unreachable-vm evidence, only a soft 'not verifiable from this checkout' note. Two factual/correctness defects compound this: the census note claiming missing numbers 'were never committed to this repo on main' is false for #001 (committed in 678b9b7, removed as 'fabricated' in 64e063e), and 009-legacy-handoff-template.md (an empty template) is marked included though the contract defaults templates to excluded/EX-template — a defect that will propagate into the node-08 handoffs layer. Criterion 2 (recording + reasons + reproducibility) passes mechanically at moderate confidence with those risks flagged; criterion 3 (chronology) passes cleanly. Overall: the enumeration and chronology work is real, but the classification completeness — the stated purpose of the node ('resolve each artifact on every axis') — is not satisfied.
